**Rate Constant ($k$):** It is defined as the rate of a chemical reaction when the concentration of each reactant is unity.

**Unit of Second-Order Rate Constant:** $	ext{L mol}^{-1}	ext{s}^{-1}$ or $	ext{mol}^{-1}	ext{dm}^3	ext{s}^{-1}$.
proTip: Always remember that the unit of rate constant depends on the overall order of the reaction using the general formula $	ext{mol}^{1-n}	ext{L}^{n-1}	ext{s}^{-1}$.
